minutes_text:
VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 10, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Juanita Doplemore, Chair  Sylvia Contreras, Commissioner
Kenneth Osborn, Vice Chair  Mike Shaknovich, Commissioner
Ryan Antes, Commissioner  Josh Smith, Commissioner
Jesse Blanco, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Blanco called the meeting to order at 5:12 p.m.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Blanco, Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith

Also present: Erica Valencia-Adachi, Collective Impact Manager, Gina Overholt, Coordinator.

Christina Boatwright, Resource Connections Division Officer, Nick Kaspar, Chief of Staff for CD 3,
Councilmember Kristina Duggan, Brian Martinez, Chief of Staff for CD 7, Ericka Monleon, Kevin Real,
Britny Coker-Moen, Leo Lerma, James and Henry Schotter, Jessie Soria, Gus Orozco and Becky
Ruesten.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Chair Blanco led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-51741  Recommendation to approve minutes for Veterans Affairs Commission meeting on
  December 13, 2023

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Doplemore, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  7  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Blanco
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Page 1 of 3
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 10, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

2.  24-51742  Recommendation to approve elected chair and vice chair

  Chair Blanco opened the floor to nominations for Chair and Vice Chair. The
  Commission elected Juanita Doplemore as Chair, and Kenneth Osborn as Vice
  Chair, and then approved the slate.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Shaknovich, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  7  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Blanco
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

3.  24-51743  Recommendation to discuss Veterans banners pilot program

  Veterans banners subcommittee chair Smitty reported on progress to date and next
  steps: reviewing design options, selecting the vendor, finalizing the content of the
  nomination form and promoting the nomination period. The subcommittee will be
  meeting more regularly to move the project forward with the objective of installing
  the banners in May (before Memorial Day).

  A motion was made by Commissioner Antes, seconded by Commissioner
  Smith, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  7  Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Blanco
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

4.  24-51744  Recommendation to discuss subcommittees

  The Commission discussed adding a new subcommittee to focus on aligning our
  activities the strategic plan. They explored whether such a subcommittee is
  necessary and tabled the item.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Contreras, seconded by Commissioner
  Smith, Laid Over. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7 Antes, Contreras, Doplemore, Osborn, Shaknovich, Smith, Blanco
  No:  0 None

  Page 2 of 3
   VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 10, 2024
  2525 GRAND AVENUE
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 0 None

PUBLIC COMMENT

No public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

Staff reminded the Commissioners to reach out to their respective Councilmembers to recruit new
Commissioners to take their place (several will time out by July 1), and reported on a strategic plan
alignment subcommittee, the February meeting, which will include a review of the Brown Act and
Robert’s Rules, and nominating Veterans for the banners program. Staff also presented certificates of
recognition to various organizations, individuals, City employees and electeds who helped make the
Veterans Day event a success. Staff presented a slideshow featuring Veterans Day event photos.

Upcoming events: Veteran Stand Down on February 24 at Garden Grove Elks Club, and the “Modern
Warrior” performance on January 17 at Bob Hope Patriotic Hall.

ADJOURNMENT

Chair Doplemore adjourned the meeting at 5:57 p.m. The holiday celebration followed.
